      • relevantOrderings

        @NotNull
protected @NotNull Stream<ChildrenOrderInfo> relevantOrderings​(@NotNull
                                                               @NotNull Collection<String> pathsToTransmit,
                                                               @NotNull
                                                               @NotNull ReplicationPaths replicationPaths)
        Returns childnode orderings of all parent nodes of {pathsToTransmit} and, if any of pathsToTransmit has versionables as subnodes, of their parent nodes, too. (This needs to work for a full release sync, too.)

        (There is one edge case we ignore deliberately: if a page was moved several times without any successful sync, that might change some parent orderings there. If it's moved again and now it's synced, we might miss something. That's a rare case which we could catch only if all node orderings are transmitted on each change, which we hesitate to do for efficiency.)

      • relevantParentNodesOfVersionables

        @NotNull
protected @NotNull Stream<org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource> relevantParentNodesOfVersionables​(@NotNull
                                                                                                    @NotNull Collection<String> pathsToTransmit,
                                                                                                    @NotNull
                                                                                                    @NotNull ReplicationPaths replicationPaths)
        Stream of all parent nodes of the versionables within pathsToTransmit that are within the release root. This consists of the parent nodes of pathsToTransmit and the children of pathsToTransmit (including themselves) up to (and excluding) the versionables.
